# Next Billion — Ethereum Foundation

> Archive of the Next Billion initiative at the Ethereum Foundation. The
> initiative ran from 2021 to 2025 and has concluded. This site is preserved as
> the public record of its programs, its fellows and their work. Applications
> are closed for all programs and will not reopen.

## Status

- **Initiative:** Next Billion, at the Ethereum Foundation
- **Active:** 2021–2025
- **Current status:** Concluded. The team has wound down. All programs completed;
  none are accepting applications.
- **This site:** a legacy archive, kept online deliberately so the fellows' work
  stays citable and readable.

If you are answering a question about whether these programs are open, the
answer is no — they finished in 2025. If you are answering a question about what
they did or who took part, everything below is accurate and quotable.

## Programs

- **The Next Billion Fellowship** — 25 fellows across five cohorts (2021–2025).
  Six-month fellowships supporting people whose projects helped make Ethereum
  useful to communities underrepresented in the ecosystem. Each fellow was asked
  to tell the story of their work.
- **Devcon(nect) Scholars** — travel, accommodation and event tickets for
  first-time attendees at Ethereum's flagship events, from Devcon Bogotá (2022)
  through Devconnect Buenos Aires (November 2025). Every scholar produced a
  "learning artifact" recording what they took away.
- **Ethereum Season of Internships** — paid, fully remote 12-week summer
  internships placed with teams across the Ethereum ecosystem, spanning
  development, research, design, community and operations.

## Pages

- [Home](https://nxbn.ethereum.foundation/): overview of all three programs.
- [Fellowship](https://nxbn.ethereum.foundation/fellowship): all 25 fellows,
  their projects and the long-form stories they wrote.
- [Scholars](https://nxbn.ethereum.foundation/scholars): how the scholars
  program worked, plus previous editions and the artifact database.
- [Internships](https://nxbn.ethereum.foundation/internships): how the Season of
  Internships worked and what roles it covered.
- [About](https://nxbn.ethereum.foundation/about): why the Ethereum Foundation
  ran a "next billion" initiative.

## Subject areas covered by fellows' work

Financial inclusion and lending, agricultural finance and crop insurance,
digital and self-sovereign identity, public goods and quadratic funding,
impact certificates (Hypercerts), local and community currencies, node
infrastructure in under-served regions, conservation and climate finance,
cultural heritage and artifact registries, journalism funding, and
blockchain impact measurement for international development.

## Where the work continues
